phase_policies.applies_when: Early game, both players are on a ground macro posture with heavy economies. Opponent shows light or uncertain tech and moderate production.
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck when you see the opponent's tech or production increase, or if you scout an early attack.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Prioritize economy and ground defense, maintain production, and adapt to scouting.
phase_policies.target: Maintain your ground army and economy, strengthen your ground forces, and keep your defense solid. Continue developing with safety checks.
phase_policies.title: Early Ground Macro with Heavy Economy
phase_policies.veto: Do not overcommit to economy at the expense of scouting or defense; avoid neglecting safety checks for early attacks.

phase_policies.applies_when: Early midgame, you have a moderate economy but a heavy expansion. Opponent shows a ground posture with moderate production.
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck when your economy is on par or if you scout an attack.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Focus on economy and ground strength, maintain expansion, and stay alert for enemy aggression.
phase_policies.target: Increase your economy, maintain your expansion and defense, and strengthen your ground army. Continue developing with safety checks.
phase_policies.title: Early Midgame Economy and Ground
phase_policies.veto: Do not overcommit to expansion without ensuring defense; avoid neglecting scouting for tech switches.

phase_policies.applies_when: Midgame, both players have heavy economies and heavy production. Opponent shows moderate tech and ground posture.
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck when you see the opponent's tech or army composition change, or if you plan to transition.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Sustain ground army and economy, consider tech transitions, and maintain defense.
phase_policies.target: Continue to strengthen your ground army, maintain your economy and production, and keep your defense up. Consider adding tech when safe.
phase_policies.title: Midgame Ground Sustain
phase_policies.veto: Do not overcommit to tech without sufficient army; avoid neglecting scouting for tech switches.

phase_policies.applies_when: Late midgame, both players have heavy economies and heavy production. Opponent shows moderate tech and ground posture with Roach cues.
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck when you see the opponent's tech or army composition change, or if you plan to transition.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Maintain ground strength, consider upgrades or tech, and keep economy stable.
phase_policies.target: Maintain your ground army and economy, continue to strengthen your ground forces, and consider adding upgrades or tech to gain an edge.
phase_policies.title: Late Midgame Ground Power
phase_policies.veto: Do not overcommit to tech without sufficient army; avoid neglecting scouting for tech switches.

experiment_feedback.use_boundary: Prioritize execution risks only; never infer the strategic target from agent outcomes.
